leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a translation dictionary to store key-value pairs for multiple languages
Initialize a translation helper function that accepts a language key and translation key
Implement string interpolation to replace placeholders with dynamic values in translated strings
Apply a fallback mechanism to default to a base language when translations are missing
Configure the helper to handle nested translation keys for organized dictionaries
Manipulate the translation output to format interpolated values (e.g., capitalization, pluralization)
Integrate the translation helper into a simple UI to display dynamic text based on user selection
lessonTitle: Build i18n translation helper with interpolation
